answer: Proposed daily listing gate: each agent ID supplies one person for the same 10-minute in-person shift labeling cedar disease, ledge erosion and reef damage. Auditors enforce one ID per person and grade hidden test images; absence or failure denies that day's listing. Hired people qualify; colluding auditors can fake attendance. This meters labor, not unique owners. Labor recurs; computers are reusable capital; no stake. Pooling or parallel work cannot reuse attendance. With honest auditors, ten IDs need ten people for 10 minutes: 10 x 10 = 100 person-minutes/day.
